name: Glasswake Surveyor

provenance.brief: Independent landmark-driven biped with fitted layered armor, articulated hands, a named weapon socket, readable windup/strike/recovery and a seven-clip native classic rig.

design_rationale: A slender pale ceramic surveyor carries a split acoustic measuring fork and a blue-grey mantle. Equipment integration and multiple readable actions are transferred into a separate non-Egyptian industrial identity; no reference spear/sword arrangement or cached animation is reused.
